headline: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited reports financial results for period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the exchange. The filing provides official figures on the company's financial performance during the quarter. Retail investors can review these reported numbers to assess the operational health of the entity. This filing adds to the ongoing stream of corporate disclosures for the period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers update financial health of the firm

headline: Vedanta Aluminium Metal files postal ballot results
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited has submitted its scrutinizer's report following a recent postal ballot. The company has officially disclosed the voting results to the exchange. This filing confirms the completion of the corporate governance process for the resolutions put to shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance update with no direct impact on retail portfolios.
